text:
zoe (PM): Quick heads-up: customers reported confusing ownership when saving presets from the Console. "Save for route" sometimes shows "created by Org Default" in the UI even though the route has its own saved preset. Need to align API -> console mapping before we ship.

alex (eng): Can you paste an example of the API response that led to this?

zoe (PM): Here's the payload we saw in staging (sanitized):

```
GET /api/v1/presets?route_id=route-123
[
  {"id":"p-200","name":"high-qa","scope":"route","owner":"org-9","created_by":"svc:defaults","applies_to":["route","model"]}
]
```

The console interpreted `owner` as "origin" and showed the org badge.

ken (platform): That's a schema smell. Our docs say `owner` is the tenancy owner; `origin` is supposed to indicate where the preset came from (user vs org default). We never enforced `origin` in the route endpoint.

nina (design): From UX: we need both pieces: (1) instant cue of who controls edits (editable vs inherited) and (2) provenance for audit. Prefer two flat fields: `editable_by` (enum: "route_owner|org_admin|team_admin") and `provenance` (string: "org_default|user_saved|import").

alex (eng): Implementation-wise, adding two fields is fine. But we should be careful: `editable_by` depends on RBAC rules which vary across Dedicated vs Hosted. Suggest adding `editable_by` as an array of roles to keep it future-proof.

sam (sre): Telemetry side: current event for saves is `preset.save.v1` with fields {preset_id, user_id}. We need to expand to include `prev_effective_id`, `new_effective_id`, `provenance`, and `preview_cost_delta` so we can detect silent upgrades.

zoe (PM): Also important: audit trail. Audit logs need to record whether a save was an override or a creation. Audit-bot should emit an audit entry for all preset writes.

audit-bot: Audit entry created: action=preset.update resource=p-200 user=zoe@redwood.org time=2025-11-03T14:02:17Z

alex (eng): Rollout strategy: 1) API adds new fields read-only, 2) console reads but doesn't change UX, 3) after 2 weeks flip UI to use `editable_by` + `provenance`. Feature flag `preset_provenance_v1` to control.

ken (platform): Backwards compat: we can keep `owner` and `created_by` for 30 days but include the new fields. Also add a small compatibility header `X-Presets-Schema: v2-preview`.

nina (design): For the console, when a preset is inherited we should show a tiny tooltip: "Inherited from Org defaults — edits must be made in Org settings" with a link. For overrides show "This overrides Org default" with a diff affordance.

zoe (PM): Edge case: when a route-level preset is imported from an Org default (copied) we should mark provenance as `imported` not `org_default` because user now owns it.

alex (eng): Good call. Add `provenance_detail` string that can be freeform like `copied_from:org-9` to avoid future renames. Keep it optional.

sam (sre): I'll add an alert rule to the infra board: if `preview_cost_delta` > 15% and `provenance` == 'org_default' trigger `preset-cost-regression` pager.

ken (platform): API snippet I'll land in PR:

```
{
  "id":"p-200",
  "name":"high-qa",
  "scope":"route",
  "owner":"org-9",
  "editable_by":["org_admin","route_owner"],
  "provenance":"imported",
  "provenance_detail":"copied_from:org-9",
  "preview_cost_tokens":2100
}
```

alex (eng): Tests: add client mapping tests for old->new schema and a contract test to ensure `X-Presets-Schema` header present in preview mode.

zoe (PM): Timeline: ken sends PR today, eng reviews tomorrow, feature flag on for 10% of orgs Thursday, full rollout next Tuesday if no issues.

nina (design): UX microcopy for the tooltip: "This preset is managed at the Org level. To change defaults across routes, update Org defaults." I'll post alt copy.

sam (sre): Ops checklist: (1) telemetry fields added, (2) alert rule for cost regressions, (3) dashboard card showing number of inherited vs overridden presets. I'll mock the dashboard query: `SELECT count(*) FROM preset_events WHERE provenance='org_default' GROUP BY org_id`

alex (eng): One more infra ask: when console shows diff between inherited vs route preset, we should surface fallback model hints if route has capacity fallback configured. Add field `fallback_reason` (`capacity|compatibility`) and `fallback_model_id`.

ken (platform): Will include those. Ok landing PR now: https://internal.redwood/pr/3129 (compat shim + tests).

zoe (PM): Thanks. Actionables: ken PR + compatibility window, alex tests & flag, nina copy + small tooltip, sam alert + dashboard query. Sync tomorrow 10m after standup.

alex (eng): Ack, will add unit + integration tests.

ken (platform): Deploy bot: deploy-preview to staging started at 2025-11-04T09:10:05Z :building_construction:

audit-bot: Audit entry created: action=preset.read resource=route-123 user=ken@redwood.org time=2025-11-04T09:10:07Z

sam (sre): I'll draft the alert PR and a dashboard tile mock.

zoe (PM): Great. Thanks everyone.
